items.title: Pauline Hanson delivers CPAC London speech to mostly empty seats
items.description: Pauline Hanson has ended her trip to Britain and Europe on a muted note, after around 120 people attended her speech at a political conference in London on Saturday.

items.title: Eight killed, 60 wounded, as Ukraine attacks Russian warehouses
items.description: Two sprawling warehouses of Russia's major online retailer are hit by Ukrainian drones, local officials say, with massive plumes of smoke towering over a facility at Elektrostal, 50 kilometres east of Moscow.

items.title: 'Lack of evidence' means Lao officials won't lay charges over teens' deaths
items.description: Investigators in Laos gave one of their first detailed accounts of the investigation into the deaths of six people, including 19-year-old Australians Holly Morton-Bowles and Bianca Jones, saying they don't have enough evidence to lay charges because autopsies were not carried out.

items.title: Footage shows Australian man handcuffed by ICE agents in Las Vegas airport
items.description: The 57-year-old, who was later arrested for overstaying his visa, was detained at an ICE processing centre in California.

items.title: Subsidy changes prompt battery installation collapse
items.description: Federal subsidies have ignited huge demand for batteries, but a tightening of the rules has experts warning of "boom and bust" cycles for the industry.

items.title: Indian activist on hunger strike forcibly removed by police
items.description: Sonam Wangchuk, who began a hunger strike last month in solidarity with India's youth party after an examination scandal affected millions of students, was forced to go to hospital by court order due to his "deteriorating health condition".

items.title: US targets bridges, Iran hits desalination plant as war threat widens
items.description: Washington and Tehran have been testing the limits of escalation since their ceasefire agreement collapsed last week, raising the prospect of a return to all-out war.

items.title: Wallabies thrash Italy as Schmidt era ends in triumph
items.description: The Wallabies record a convincing 57-10 victory over Italy in Perth, as Joe Schmidt's coaching tenure finishes on a winning note.

items.title: Pies get home against Blues, Lions survive Eagles scare
items.description: Collingwood completes a 21-point win over rivals Carlton, as Brisbane is forced to work for a 24-point victory over West Coast.

items.title: 'It's not right': Dragons fume after pushing Warriors
items.description: Second-placed New Zealand Warriors squeak to a nervy 20-12 victory over wooden-spoon favourite St George Illawarra, although the Dragons fume over narrow refereeing calls.

items.title: 'Failed' university scheme hurting home ownership prospects
items.description: There are calls for the government to dump a scheme that has more than doubled the cost of some degrees.

items.title: India successfully launches nation's first private orbital rocket
items.description: India's first privately developed orbital rocket, the Vikram-1, has successfully lifted off on its maiden orbital mission.

items.title: Early-onset bowel cancer becoming more prevalent as signs are missed
items.description: Georgie Cauchi had blood in her stool, constant pain and was struggling to get out of bed, but still in her 20s doctors told her she was too young to have bowel cancer. When it was finally discovered several years later, the tumour had grown so large it was blocking her entire bowel.

items.title: Meet 'Jimothy', the viral, short-spined raccoon who roams Seattle
items.description: A raccoon with a rare birth defect has amassed a legion of fans after a video of it darting across a footpath and running up a set of stairs racked up more than 6.8 million views in just three days.

items.title: Failed interns get a second chance to become doctors in new Aussie drama
items.description: Growing up, Ioane Sa'ula thought he'd probably play rugby league professionally, but an injury scuppered his plans. Now, he's the romantic lead of new Aussie medical drama, The F Ward.

items.title: This dal is a quick, simple and satisfying winter warmer
items.description: Lentils are having a moment and this easy dal is an incredibly easy way to make the most of them.

items.title: ABC 5050 quiz: Testing your knowledge of Sam Neill's Marvel cameo, 70s punk rock and traffic cones
items.description: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right, the other is wrong. But there's a catch.

items.title: Olympic swimmers return to iconic Sydney pool for 50-year reunion
items.description: Members of the 1976 Australian Olympic swim team return to North Sydney Olympic pool to celebrate their 50-year reunion and revisit the venue that shaped their careers.

items.title: 'Dangerously close to becoming normalised': Government responds to Islamophobia report
items.description: The Albanese government's long-awaited response to its special envoy's report on Islamophobia has rejected calls for an overhaul of counter-terror laws.

items.title: Researchers working on artificial placentas for premature babies
items.description: The aim of the technology is to give babies born too soon a few more weeks to grow and develop in womb-like conditions, and a better chance of a long and healthy life.

items.title: China has stockpiled 'huge quantities' of frozen beef for this moment
items.description: As imports from Australia hit a wall because of large tariffs, China turns to its historically high stockpile of frozen beef.

items.title: Three years after fatal shark attack, community cements teacher's legacy
items.description: A regional community was left shaken after Simon Baccanello was killed in a shark attack in 2023. Now, his legacy will be cemented through a new sporting complex.

items.title: Millions of couples share this remarkable trait. Researchers still don't know why
items.description: Once I saw it, I couldn't unsee it. Had I noticed something real or was it just the people around me? I set out to find out what the data had to say.

items.title: Arrival of huge US thrift chain Savers unsettles Geelong op shops
items.description: Charity op shops in Geelong are feeling threatened by the arrival of US megastore Savers.

items.title: Fugitive busted pretending to fish as driver stuck in outback 'nightmare'
items.description: After agreeing to help smuggle an alleged drug trafficker out of Australia, Stephen Roche found himself at the centre of a living "nightmare", stranded in the outback without funds or friends, court documents have revealed.
